articles.summary: Proposed acquisition adds a diverse pipeline of assets focused on elevating the standard of care for patients with dermatologic, respiratory and other related inflammatory and immunological diseases Apogee's lead asset, zumilokibart (APG777), is a late-stage, half-life extended monoclonal antibody
articles.title: AbbVie to Acquire Apogee Therapeutics, Deepening Immunology Portfolio
